name: sandy_loam

source.theta_fc: [C] inside the FAO-56 Table 19 sandy loam range 0.18-0.28 (Allen et al. 1998, ch. 7); the value is [AS].
source.theta_wp: [C] inside the FAO-56 Table 19 sandy loam range 0.06-0.16; the value is [AS]. theta_fc - theta_wp = 0.12 is just under the Table 19 range 0.11-0.15 midpoint.
source.fallow_root_depth_m: [AS] depth of the 'root zone' bucket of bare soil.

source.rew_mm: [C] FAO-56 Table 19, sandy loam REW 6-10 mm. TEW is derived (eq 73) = 17.5 mm, inside the Table 19 range 15-20.

source.curve_number_ii: [AS] SCS curve number, small grain, good condition, hydrologic soil group A/B boundary (NEH-4, recalled, not re-read).

source: F1a drought-prone contrast soil (low available water): used by the drought tests.
